'''2007 Australian Championship Neil Kane LS Thrown Back (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Neil Kane]] at [[2007 Australian Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Thrown Back (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-21-Thrown_Back-remaster.webp|label=Thrown Back (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
